seoTitle: App of the Dead — Learn World Religions Free
metaDescription: Where will your soul go? Face the Judgment of six afterlives, then learn what 22 religions believe in 5-minute lessons, and ask the gods on your iPhone.
keywords: learn religion like a language app
heroHeadline: Where will your soul go? Six afterlives are about to tell you.
heroSubhead: App of the Dead opens with the Judgment: nine questions from the guardians of the dead weigh your soul by Egyptian, Greek, Norse, Aztec, Zoroastrian and Buddhist rules. Then explore 22 traditions in five-minute lessons, neutral, respectful and made for the curious.
highlights: The Judgment: your verdict in six traditions, and a Soul Card to share
22 traditions side by side, each a path of story-card lessons on its own map
Ask the Oracle: deity guides answer on your iPhone, instantly with Apple Intelligence

features.title: The Judgment
features.body: Thoth reads your record, Charon asks for his coin, Odin asks how your story ends, and Anubis weighs your heart against the feather of Ma'at. See where you would go, from the Field of Reeds to Valhalla, and share your Soul Card.

features.title: Every belief, side by side
features.body: Walk a path through Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Norse, Egyptian, Greek and more. See where the world's oldest answers agree and where they diverge.

features.title: Learn through play
features.body: Multiple-choice, matching, and true/false quizzes make Olam Ha-Ba, Valhalla, reincarnation, and the Duat stick. No dry textbook reading.

features.title: The Oracle
features.body: Chat with Anubis, Odin, Hecate, Azrael and other guides. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence and iOS 26 or later the Oracle answers at once with Apple's on-device model; other iPhones download a model once. Your questions never leave your phone.

features.title: Built to keep you learning
features.body: Every tradition is a path map of story-card lessons. A Daily Omen asks one question a day from any faith, streaks turn five minutes into a habit, and XP and badges mark each path you finish.

features.title: Respectful by design
features.body: Every tradition is presented neutrally, with equal weight and no proselytizing. This is education, not conversion.

howItWorks.body: Answer nine guardians of the dead in about two minutes and get your verdict in six traditions. Finish it and every path and every god opens for a week, with nothing to sign up for.
Take a five-minute lesson a day on a tradition's path map, answer the Daily Omen, and watch your XP and badges climb.
Keep every path and unlimited Oracle conversations with Premium, add single traditions, or stay on the Judaism path, free forever.

faq.q: How much does App of the Dead cost?
faq.a: The full Judaism path is free forever, with no account and no time limit. Premium unlocks all 21 other paths and unlimited Oracle chat: $19.99/year or $2.99/month in the US.

faq.q: Is there a one-time purchase instead of a subscription?
faq.a: Yes. Ultimate Enlightenment is a one-time lifetime unlock if you would rather own everything outright. You can also buy individual belief systems one at a time.
Lessons, quizzes and the Judgment work offline. The Oracle runs on your iPhone: instantly with Apple Intelligence on iOS 26 or later, or after a one-time model download on other iPhones.
Yes. Oracle conversations are processed on your iPhone, by Apple's on-device model or the downloaded one, so your spiritual questions never go to a chat server.

faq.q: Is this trying to convert me to a religion?
faq.a: No. App of the Dead presents all 22 traditions neutrally and with equal respect. It is built for education and comparison, not conversion, and is not affiliated with any religious organization.
App of the Dead runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 18.2 or later. The Oracle's instant answers need an iPhone with Apple Intelligence on iOS 26 or later; other iPhones download a model once.

faq.q: Can I try it before paying?
faq.a: Yes. Finish the Judgment and every path and every god opens for seven days if you have not bought anything yet, with nothing to sign up for and nothing to cancel. The full Judaism path is free forever, and the first lesson of every other path plays free. Subscriptions renew automatically through your Apple ID and can be cancelled anytime in Settings.

faq.q: Who is App of the Dead for?
faq.a: Religious-studies students, writers and worldbuilders researching afterlife lore, travelers, educators, and anyone curious about what different cultures believe comes next.
